text: In a house in Nerima, Tokyo, Takeo Saeki once [murdered his wife Kayako, his son Toshio and their cat|wrong|killing within the family] out of jealousy, and their grudge lingers there. The social worker Rika, sent to care for an old woman, finds a boy named Toshio there and watches the woman die. Anyone who [steps inside that house|rules|break the rule and pay] is followed home by the curse, which [spreads to every place they die|ending|the evil spreads], so detectives, a schoolgirl and an office guard are claimed in turn, in [photographs with their eyes blacked out|images|pictures, screens and recordings].
